whenToUse: Human-readable history on a record: created, stage changed, email sent, comment added.
A dashboard activity feed grouped by day.
Approval and order steps that already happened.
avoidWhen: A forensic who-did-what ledger with filters and IP data — use Audit log.
Future steps of a process — use Stepper or Approval flow.
Discussions people reply to — use Comment thread.
a11y: Entries form a list; actors are named in text, not only via avatars.
Relative times keep an absolute timestamp in the datetime attribute and tooltip.
